purpose: Separate short-hop storm geometry from local condensation on the corrected common-mass two-branch transport basis. No shared wind retuning or planetary changes.
physical_definition: Fix r39 shared winds, common-mass two-branch moisture transport (lower mass fraction .25, upper/lower humidity ratio .2,1km thermal shear), and all rainfall/planetary parameters. Existing conservative storm closure takes6 nonnegative short hops, each Gaussian width reduced by sqrt(6); local capacity is existing crest saturation / eddy_rainout. Hops-only uses1e-6 as a practically unlimited capacity: report actual condensation at every primer/scored step, do not assume it vanishes. Compare fixed strengths .5/.75 to isolate condensation from changed transport geometry. Vapor plus local condensate is conserved; condensate remains at formation cells. Same finite-step redistribution, not a resolved storm trajectory. These choices repeat established operator-attribution values under a newly corrected transport basis, rather than refining the failed wind search.
control: Seven original r39 results and native wind controls exact, followed by seven archived mass_tracer020 common-mass controls exact. All arrays, budgets and native footprints reproduce before21 new strict integrations. No adaptive extra strengths, altered error limits or post-hoc screening.

Same accuracy guards: S<=.995, mean rain ratio<=.99,T ratio<=1.01; NI rain ratio<=.95; Iran<=1.02; every other region S<=1.02. No additional candidate, weakened threshold or new validation sampling after outcomes. Also require two_layer_transport certificate with dry-column residual<=1e-10 and EACH branch wind maximum<=60m/s,p95<=25m/s (all primer/scored steps), rather than hiding a fast return in the weighted mean. Exactly3 fixed storm profiles, no additional strengths after outcomes.
